name: Bouncy Bombs

features.name: Bomb Multipliers
features.description: Add their values together and multiply the round's total.

features.name: Revealing bombs
features.description: Hide larger multipliers until they explode.

features.name: Total Win Bar
features.description: Collects every win from the round.

review:
A 6x5 fruit scatter-pays game where wins go into a Total Win Bar and the bombs go off at the end of the round. Normal bombs show 2x to 4x, revealing bombs hide 5x and up, and every bomb on the grid adds together before multiplying the total.

The catch: bombs only count if there was at least one win that round, so a board full of bombs with no win is a painful near miss. Very easy to follow. 10,000x max in every mode.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
